title: unwrap() calls on try_into lack SAFETY comments
description:
Location: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs lines 369, 380, 381, 440, 448, 449, 517, 523

Issue: Multiple .unwrap() calls on slice.try_into() conversions. While safe (slice lengths are validated beforehand), no comments explain why unwrap is justified.

Example at line 369:
    SIGNATURE_LENGTH => Some(sig_data.try_into().unwrap()),

Per rust-review.md: .unwrap()/.expect() outside tests/examples without justification is flagged.

Suggested fix: Add inline comments or use .expect() with explanation:
    sig_data.try_into().expect("length checked above")
